key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:5D4E
name: walk_grid_cells_with_callbacks
description: Walks a row of grid cells starting from the record's coordinates. It calls the first callback on each entry in a cell's list and the second callback after each step, returning the first non-zero callback result or zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:5D7A
name: walk_cells_via_callbacks
description: Walks grid cells along a row from the record's coordinates, calling two function pointers taken from a context structure: one on each entry of a cell's list and one per step. It returns the first non-zero callback result, or zero when the walk ends.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:5E68
name: scan_grid_column_with_callbacks
description: Repeats a scan across grid cells: it calls a step callback, advances the cell position, looks up each cell and invokes an entry callback on every item in that cell's list. It stops with zero when the step callback reports non-zero or the count is exceeded.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:5E98
name: find_matching_neighbor_in_cells
description: Scans grid cells outward from the record's position in the direction given by the sign of the second argument. It returns one when it finds another flagged record with a matching character field, and zero when it reaches a blocking cell or the end of the scan.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:5EC8
name: scan_column_for_matching_record
description: Scans cells from the record's position for another flagged record whose character field equals a byte from the context structure. The direction follows the sign of a signed count held in the context, and it returns one on a match and zero otherwise.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:5EDA
name: scan_fixed_column_for_record
description: Scans a fixed column of grid cells from the record's position for another flagged record whose character field matches a byte from the context structure. It returns one when a match is found, the same as the variant that takes a variable count, and zero when the scan is blocked or ends.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:6008
name: scan_cells_for_flagged_match
description: Walks grid cells from the record's position over a fixed number of steps and returns one when it finds a flagged record other than the argument whose character field matches the context's character. It returns zero when a blocking cell or the end of the scan is reached.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:6108
name: find_flagged_neighbor_by_character
description: Scans grid cells from the record's position, in a direction set by the sign of the second argument, for another flagged record with a non-negative second field whose character is one or a newline code. It returns one on a match and zero when the scan is blocked or finishes.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:6138
name: find_flagged_neighbor_from_context
description: Scans grid cells from the record's position for another flagged record whose character is one or a newline code. The count and direction come from the context structure, and the routine returns one on a match and zero otherwise.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:614A
name: find_flagged_neighbor_fixed_column
description: Scans a fixed column of grid cells from the record's position for another flagged record with a non-negative second field and a character of one or a newline code. It returns one when found, and zero when the scan is blocked or ends.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:628A
name: step_cells_for_flagged_neighbor
description: Steps through a sequence of grid cells from the record's position looking for another flagged record whose character is one or a newline code. It returns one on a match and zero when the count runs out or a blocking cell is hit.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:62D2
name: scan_row_for_flagged_neighbor
description: Walks a row of grid cells from the record's position looking for a flagged record other than the argument whose character is one or a newline code. It returns one on the first match and zero when the row is blocked or exhausted.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:639C
name: count_cell_entry_callbacks
description: Walks grid cells from the record's position, invoking an entry callback on each record in each visited cell and summing the results. The step callback ends the walk when it returns non-zero, and the accumulated total is returned.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:63D4
name: accumulate_grid_callback_totals
description: Walks grid cells from the record's position in a direction set by the context, adding up the results of an entry callback over each record in each cell. The total is kept in the context and returned, and a step callback held in the context ends the walk when it returns non-zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:64CA
name: sum_entry_callbacks_across_cells
description: Walks a sequence of grid cells, adding the results of an entry callback over every record in each cell into a total kept in the context. The walk stops when the step callback returns non-zero and the total is returned.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:64FE
name: match_flagged_record_opposite_parity
description: Returns one when the first record differs from the second, carries flag bit four, has the given character, has a parity bit that differs from the second record's, and a subsidiary check on the first record returns zero. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: return_constant_zero

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:659E
name: match_flagged_record_same_parity
description: Returns one when the first record differs from the second, carries flag bit four, has the given character, has a parity bit equal to the second record's, and a subsidiary check on the first record returns zero. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: return_constant_zero
description: The routine takes no arguments and returns zero unconditionally. It is reached only through a pointer stored in the data section.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:6620
name: find_first_nonzero_entry_result
description: Walks grid cells from the record's position, invoking the entry callback on each record in each cell. It returns as soon as the accumulated result is non-zero, and the step callback ends the walk when it reports non-zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:6656
name: accumulate_entry_callbacks_until_nonzero
description: Walks grid cells, adding entry callback results into a context total. It returns the total as soon as it is non-zero, and otherwise stops when the step callback reports non-zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:674C
name: accumulate_row_callbacks_until_nonzero
description: Steps along a row of grid cells, calling a context step callback on each step and adding entry callback results into the context total. It returns the total as soon as it is non-zero or zero when the row ends or the step callback reports non-zero.

name: dispatch_opposite_parity_match
description: Checks that the first record differs from the second, carries flag bit four, has the given character and has a parity bit that differs from the second record's. When a subsidiary check on the first record is non-zero, it passes a value built from both records' fields to another routine and returns one.

name: forward_with_two_callbacks
description: Forwards its two arguments to another routine together with two callback addresses and returns nothing. It is referenced from a handler pointer in the data section.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:6924
name: return_first_entry_callback_hit
description: Walks grid cells from the record's position and calls the entry callback on each record in each visited cell, returning that callback's result as soon as it is non-zero. The step callback ends the walk with zero when it reports non-zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:695A
name: walk_cells_until_entry_hit
description: Walks a counted range of grid cells from the record's position, calling the entry callback taken from the context on each record in each cell. It returns the first non-zero callback result, and the step callback taken from the context ends the walk when it returns non-zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:6A4C
name: scan_row_callbacks_until_hit
description: Steps through a row of grid cells, calling the context's step callback each time and invoking the entry callback on every record in each cell. It returns the first non-zero entry result, or zero when the row ends or a step reports non-zero.

name: return_constant_zero

description: Checks that the first record differs from the second, has flag bit four, and has a character of one, ten or twelve. It picks one of four codes from the parity of both records and whether the third argument is zero, then passes that code on; when that succeeds it passes the first record's byte field on and returns one.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:6ADE
name: dispatch_field_after_check
description: Runs a check without arguments and, when it succeeds, passes the record's byte field to another routine and returns one. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:6B7E
name: walk_cells_by_record_range
description: Walks grid cells from the record's position over a range read from a record field, calling an entry callback on each record in each cell and a step callback per step. It returns the first non-zero entry result, or zero when the walk ends or the step callback reports non-zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:6BB4
name: walk_cells_counted_until_hit
description: Walks a counted range of grid cells from the record's position, calling each entry callback through the context structure and returning its first non-zero result. The context's step callback ends the walk when it returns non-zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:6CA6
name: return_first_row_callback_hit
description: Steps along a row of grid cells, invoking the context's entry callback on each record it finds and returning the first non-zero result. The context's step callback ends the row early when it reports non-zero.

name: return_constant_zero

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:6DA4
name: initialize_and_update_table
description: Fills a block of the global table with all-ones values, then walks the stored entries and writes each entry's index into one of three table locations, chosen by comparing the entry's group byte with stored bytes. Only entries whose computed slot is below the limit are written.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:6EF8
name: compare_word_against_global
description: Returns minus one when the low word of its second argument equals a stored global word, and zero otherwise.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:6F0C
name: return_constant_minus_one
description: The routine takes no arguments and returns minus one unconditionally. It is reached through a pointer stored in the data section.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:6F12
name: initialize_audio_and_link_table
description: Resets global state including the audio volume values, points several global pointers at their storage and clears a 256-byte table. It then runs the unpacking helper and builds a singly linked list of entries in a memory block before returning.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:7142
name: iterate_object_table_updates
description: Makes three passes over a table of object records from the highest index down to zero. Each record is either handled by a helper call when its flag bit is set, or has its stored byte copied into global state before the helper call, and the global state is cleared at the end.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:73F6
name: run_frame_input_and_display
description: Processes one frame: it reads the input state, updates a state machine driven by key codes, and writes display and DMA control registers. It then swaps the frame buffers and waits for the vertical blank, returning the value from that wait.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:78AA
name: execute_routine_then_loop_forever
description: Calls one other routine and then spins in an infinite loop without returning. The referenced score and congratulations text is drawn by the routines it calls, not by this code.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:799E
name: call_routine_then_spin_forever
description: Calls a single routine and then loops forever without returning. The referenced score and press-to-continue text belongs to the routines it calls, not to this code.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:7B32
name: build_and_draw_message_lines
description: Builds two text lines in a buffer by copying a string and appending separator characters, draws each line at a fixed screen position, and then waits on a state register until a flag is set before returning.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:7B5E
name: draw_message_lines_then_wait
description: Builds two text lines by copying a string and appending separator characters, draws each at a fixed screen position, and then waits on a state register until a flag is set and a second global is zero before returning.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:7B8A
name: wait_for_flag_then_return
description: Writes a fixed value to a global variable and returns once a flag bit is set and a second global is zero. Otherwise it loops without end.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:7BB0
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: After decompilation only an endless loop with no meaningful instructions remains, so this is a stub rather than a working routine.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:7C7E
name: initialize_game_state_and_tables
description: Resets global state and several pointer variables, clears a 256-byte table and runs the unpacking helper. It links the entries of a block into a list and XORs a block of global words with a stored table before returning.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:7F14
name: copy_entry_list_then_spin
description: Returns at once when a guard global is non-zero. Otherwise it copies a list of four-word entries from a source buffer to a destination, copies a block of globals and then loops forever.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:7F1E
name: copy_entries_and_configure_dma
description: Sets up a pending state word, copies a list of four-word entries from a source buffer to a destination and copies a block of globals. It then configures the bitplane DMA and loops forever.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:7FD6
name: copy_entry_block_from_context
description: Copies a block of four-word entries whose count and pointers come from a context structure, then copies a fixed block of 21 words of globals. It calls a helper and then loops forever.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:8248
name: return_from_subroutine
description: The routine does nothing and returns immediately. It is called from the routine that resets global state and swaps buffers.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:829A
name: queue_positioned_draw_entry
description: Computes the screen position of an object from its coordinates and a table offset, then appends a four-word entry with the position, source pointer, object pointer and a flag to a draw list and increments the list count. For one special object type it calls a second routine that returns the position.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:854C
name: run_render_sequence_for_frame
description: Calls four helper routines in sequence and feeds one returned value into two of the later calls. It is called from three other routines.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:9D06
name: build_sprite_draw_list
description: Builds a draw list of active object records from a table, one four-word entry per object, after waiting for the previous frame and clearing a control flag. It calls the frame and text helpers and returns the accumulated value.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:AA3E
name: enable_dma_then_loop_forever
description: Writes two configuration bytes into a block, enables DMA through a control register write and sets a flag. It then runs four helper routines and loops forever.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:AB8C
name: process_eight_table_entries
description: Swaps buffers when the flag is clear or runs them through another routine, then walks eight table entries. For each non-negative entry it writes two values and calls a helper, and it returns when done.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:AEE6
name: expand_nibbles_through_table
description: Walks a packed value four bits at a time, looks each nibble up in a global table, stores the mapped byte and passes it to a helper. It repeats for a count supplied by the caller.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:AF02
name: draw_packed_nibble_text
description: Takes the nibbles of a packed value one at a time, stores each as a glyph index in a global buffer and passes the result to the text drawing helper with an offset. The loop runs for a count supplied by the caller.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:B02C
name: return_from_subroutine
description: The routine does nothing and returns immediately. It is not called from any named routine in the executable.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:B102
name: search_table_for_xor_signature
description: Scans up to twenty six-byte table entries for a four-byte signature whose bytes are XORed with fixed keys. On a match it stores the entry's word field and clears two globals, otherwise it sets a flag and runs a ten-step helper sequence.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:B1DA
name: return_from_subroutine
description: The routine does nothing and returns immediately. It is reached through a handler pointer in the data section.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:B1DC
name: process_text_entry_keystroke
description: Handles one keystroke for a name entry field: a tab deletes the last character, escape clears the field, a newline is ignored and other characters are appended up to a fixed limit. It then rebuilds the displayed text with a space or underscore cursor chosen by a counter and passes it to the draw helper.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:B228
name: append_entry_character_and_draw
description: Applies one keystroke to a text entry field: a tab removes the last character, other characters are appended up to a fixed limit, and the displayed text is rebuilt with a space or underscore cursor. The result is then passed to the draw helper.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:B438
name: adjust_counter_spin_if_flagged
description: Decrements a global when bit two is set and it is non-zero, and increments it when bit three is set and it is below twenty. It then loops forever if bit four, five or six is set, and otherwise returns.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:B956
name: start_audio_channel_sample
description: Waits for a delay loop, then programs an audio channel's sample pointer, length, period and volume registers and enables that channel's DMA. It repeats the setup with a second block after another delay.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:D8FA
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Decompilation left only an endless loop with no meaningful instructions, so the body is a stub. The helper calls listed in its facts do not appear in the pseudo-code.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:DC28
name: check_xored_bytes_advance_stage
description: Compares two byte sequences where one is XORed with a fixed key byte, counting down the length. On a mismatch it advances a stage counter; before the final stage it runs two helpers and loops forever, and at the final stage it clears a flag and returns.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:DC4C
name: initialize_display_register_defaults
description: Writes a set of default values to global colour and display-position variables, stores address-derived offsets into a list of globals and then calls helpers. It is referenced from three other routines.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:DF76
name: write_decimal_digits_from_table
description: Writes a number as ASCII digits into a buffer by repeatedly subtracting place values taken from a table, one digit per position. It ends at the final place value of one and writes the last digit.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:DFAC
name: write_decimal_digits_from_table
description: Writes a number as ASCII digits into a buffer by repeatedly subtracting place values taken from a table, one digit per position. It ends at the final place value of one and writes the last digit.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:DFB2
name: store_low_nibble_mapped_byte
description: Looks up the low nibble of the input byte in a global table and writes the mapped byte to the output location, after a helper call.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:DFBC
name: store_nibble_indexed_byte
description: Looks up the low nibble of the input byte in a global table and stores the mapped byte at the output location. It makes one helper call before storing.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:DFDC
name: configure_blitter_registers_and_call
description: Sets a mask bit in a longword and writes a fixed sequence of values to hardware-style block-copy globals, including size and mask words. It then calls helpers and returns a value built from the input.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:DFFC
name: reset_blitter_registers_and_wait
description: Writes a fixed sequence of values to the block-copy (blitter) registers, sets the size and modulo words, and calls a wait routine that spins until a flag clears before returning.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:E2E4
name: call_routine_if_flag_spin
description: Returns immediately when a global byte is negative, otherwise calls one routine and then loops forever. The many helpers listed in its facts are not visible in the decompiled body.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:F016
name: compute_scrolled_sprite_position
description: Computes a draw position from two offset globals and the current display mode, clamping it to the screen area. It then derives frame bit patterns, writes them to a buffer and calls helper routines.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:F464
name: expand_packed_pixels_to_rows
description: Reads packed longwords from a source buffer and expands each byte into words through a global lookup table, writing the results to two rows of a destination buffer. It processes a fixed number of rows and returns after the last block.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:F4C2
name: expand_packed_pixels_at_offset
description: Expands packed longwords from a buffer through a global lookup table into rows of a destination buffer, starting at an offset derived from the input and a scroll-style global. It writes a fixed number of rows and returns.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:F62A
name: expand_packed_pixels_from_table
description: Reads packed longwords and expands each byte into words through a source table supplied by the caller, writing them into two rows of a destination buffer. It repeats for a fixed number of rows.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:FA5C
name: initialize_table_offsets_from_base
description: When a helper returns non-zero, it stores that value and a series of table offsets derived from a base pointer into global variables, then calls another helper and stores its result. Otherwise it does nothing.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:FBAE
name: clear_global_when_helper_zero
description: Calls a helper and, when its result is zero, clears a global variable. Otherwise it returns with the global unchanged.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:FD8A
name: reset_state_and_clear_buffer
description: Clears several state globals and a block of 3264 bytes, writes handler pointers depending on a mode byte and the input, then calls helpers. It is called from the frame-state routines.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:FD8E
name: unpack_and_initialize_handler_table
description: Writes handler pointers into global slots depending on a mode byte, clears a block of memory and runs the unpacking helper. It then stores four words per entry through a pointer, clears pending flags and returns.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:10232
name: load_file_chunks_via_dos
description: Clears a table of ninety global pairs, reads a file table entry and uses DOS read and seek stubs to fetch its data into memory after checking free memory. It disables interrupts and closes the file when finished.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:1040E
name: select_resource_offset_by_id
description: Checks a stored identifier against a list of known values and calls a helper for matches. It then computes a resource offset from a table entry and either returns the existing value or stores the offset and size in globals.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:10534
name: compute_resource_size_and_store
description: Computes a resource offset from a table entry and, when the size is below a threshold, uses a default base. Otherwise it calls a helper and records the offset and size in globals, then unpacks the data.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:106D8
name: disable_interrupts_and_clear_flag
description: When a pending flag is set, it writes an interrupt-disable mask and a handler pointer to global slots, calls a helper, then clears the flag and returns its result. Otherwise it returns a stored counter.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:107A4
name: find_table_entry_for_code
description: When the object's code matches a special value or its type byte, it scans a table for an entry equal to that code and stores the matching value in a global. It then calls helpers and copies a run of bytes into a destination buffer.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:10800
name: copy_block_when_argument_changes
description: If its argument differs from a stored value, it stores the argument, calls helpers and copies a block of bytes whose length comes from a helper's result. The destination sits a fixed distance before the source pointer.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:10B02
name: initialize_system_state_and_flags
description: Clears a global block byte by byte, sets several flag globals and calls helpers through library-style pointers. It selects a timing multiplier from the bits of a hardware configuration word and then sets the remaining globals.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:10B06
name: start_game_and_open_libraries
description: Clears a global block, sets startup flags and opens the system libraries before setting up screen buffers and interrupt handlers. It reads the joystick buttons, loads and parses the file table, builds the palette and bit-reversal tables and waits for a frame, and its text refers to floppy and hard-disk launch messages.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:10D4C
name: save_registers_to_vector_slots
description: Writes the processor register values into fixed low-memory slots, stores a marker value and then calls the handler setup routine.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:10D7E
name: call_stored_handler_pointer
description: Writes a marker value, runs the interrupt handler setup routine and then calls through a function pointer stored in a fixed slot.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:10DA2
name: store_marker_after_helper_call
description: Writes a marker value and a stored argument into global slots, calls a helper and copies a stored value to another slot. It writes minus two through a pointer and returns the helper's result.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:10DDC
name: call_second_stored_handler_pointer
description: Writes a marker value, runs the interrupt handler setup routine and then calls through a second function pointer stored in a fixed slot.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:10F14
name: select_table_entry_update_buffer
description: Checks a record's type byte to set a flag, then looks up its entry in a table and walks a list of table entries, updating a buffer when an entry's flag is negative. A helper chooses the table entry by index.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:1100E
name: classify_record_and_copy_tiles
description: Classifies a record by comparing its identifier against a few known values and a special type byte, storing a category code. It then copies tile-map blocks and builds a sprite mask for that category before returning.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:11324
name: reset_palette_state_call_helper
description: Clears several global state variables, calls a helper and sets a count global to forty before returning the value it was given.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:11702
name: copy_palette_sprite_blocks
description: Checks an object's type byte against four known values and, when the matching global is non-negative, copies palette and sprite pattern data from the argument structure into global tables. It writes a marker into the result and returns.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:117D2
name: return_from_subroutine
description: The routine does nothing and returns immediately. It is called from one other routine.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:117D4
name: run_interrupt_setup_pair
description: Calls two helper routines in sequence and returns. One of the helpers configures the interrupt controller registers.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:1183E
name: call_two_helpers_and_return
description: Calls two helper routines in sequence and returns. It is called from the interrupt setup routines.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:11A94
name: service_frame_interrupt
description: Runs as the interrupt service routine: it updates the input state flags and decrements a counter when it is active. It then swaps palette entries, rotates a colour table, reads the joystick buttons and writes to the DMA and interrupt registers before returning.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:11F32
name: handle_keyboard_interrupt_byte
description: Reads a keyboard code from the CIA data register, records it in a key-state table and updates a flag for that key's bit. After a short delay it acknowledges the handshake bit and sets a global to eight.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:11FB4
name: set_record_field_to_eight
description: Writes the value eight into a 16-bit field at a fixed offset of the record given by its argument and returns.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:11FC0
name: install_interrupt_vectors_copy_state
description: Copies several handler pointers and offsets into global variables, computes two buffer offsets from a base and writes the handler and interrupt enable values. It then copies a block of sixteen long words and calls helpers before returning.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:11FC4
name: install_interrupt_vectors_clear_slot
description: Performs the same setup as its neighbouring routine, copying handler values, computing buffer offsets and writing interrupt enable values, but it clears a handler slot to zero instead. It copies sixteen long words and calls helpers.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:121F6
name: call_table_pointer_store_result
description: Calls a function pointer read from a fixed low-memory slot with a negative offset applied, and stores the returned value in a global. It takes no arguments.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:121FA
name: call_table_pointer_store_result
description: Calls a function pointer read from a fixed low-memory slot with a negative offset applied, and stores the returned value in a global. It takes no arguments.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:12686
name: wait_for_status_bit_set
description: Spins until bit five of a global byte is set, then returns that bit's value.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:1268A
name: wait_for_status_bit_set
description: Spins until bit five of a global byte is set, then returns that bit's value.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:127CA
name: convert_palette_nibbles_to_colors
description: Converts sixteen colour words by rearranging their nibbles, storing each result in a global table and in a palette buffer. It then calls the palette swap routine and returns.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:12A16
name: return_input_byte_unchanged
description: Returns the byte already held in the low data register without changing it. It is called from the joystick reading routine.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:12A1A
name: return_input_byte_unchanged
description: Returns the byte already held in the low data register without changing it. It is called from the joystick reading routine and one other routine.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:134E2
name: accumulate_line_text_width
description: Walks a text string until a zero, newline or pipe character, adding each glyph's width from a global table and six units for each control code. It returns the accumulated width.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:13526
name: layout_text_lines_by_width
description: Walks a text string segment by segment, measuring widths through the glyph table and tracking the running position, with pipe characters starting new lines. It returns the final layout state.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:1352C
name: layout_text_lines_from_table
description: Lays out text segments in the same way as its neighbour, but takes each segment's width from an indexed table entry before measuring. It returns the final layout state.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:1355C
name: compute_widest_text_line
description: Walks the lines of a text block separated by pipe characters, measuring each with the text width routine and keeping the widest width seen. It returns the widest value found.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:1356E
name: combine_text_segment_widths
description: Measures each pipe-separated segment of a text block and combines the segment widths into the returned value.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:13590
name: delegate_text_width_measurement
description: Calls the text width routine on its arguments and is reached from the script byte parser. The decompiled body is unavailable, so only the call relationship is known.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:137B8
name: compare_values_against_hunk_codes
description: Compares values against AmigaDOS executable hunk type codes and calls two helpers. It is reached from the text drawing and text width routines, and the visible pseudo-code is incomplete.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:137E4
name: check_hunk_type_code_pair
description: Compares two values against AmigaDOS executable hunk type codes and calls two helpers. It is called from the text width routine, and the visible pseudo-code is incomplete.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:13808
name: check_hunk_codes_call_helpers
description: Compares values against AmigaDOS hunk type codes and calls two helpers. It is called from eight other routines and the visible pseudo-code is incomplete.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:138C2
name: check_hunk_codes_via_lookup
description: Compares values against AmigaDOS hunk type codes through a table lookup and calls a helper. Two routines call it, and the visible pseudo-code is incomplete.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:13926
name: program_blitter_block_operation
description: Programs the blitter's source, destination and mask registers for a block operation, waiting for the blitter to be free between steps. The routine is very large, so the visible pseudo-code is incomplete.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:173D0
name: program_blitter_fill_and_wait
description: Writes mask, pointer and size values for a blitter operation, waits for the blitter to be free, and returns early when a flag is set. It then calls further helpers.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:1743A
name: setup_blitter_rectangle_copy
description: Writes source and destination values, masks and modulo words to the blitter globals for a rectangle operation, waits for the blitter to clear and calls a helper to clear the blitter state. The visible pseudo-code is partial.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:17EA8
name: open_and_read_data_file
description: Disables interrupts and reads a data file through the DOS open and read calls, copying the bytes into the destination buffer. It waits for the interrupt flag and resets interrupt state around the read.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:180A0
name: seek_and_read_data_file
description: Disables interrupts, opens a data file, seeks to a position and reads from it through the DOS calls, then resets interrupt state. It waits for the interrupt flag before returning.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:1824C
name: open_data_file_interrupts_off
description: Disables interrupts, opens a file through the DOS open call and resets interrupt state before returning the result.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:184A2
name: busy_wait_countdown
description: Counts a register down to zero in a tight loop as a delay, then returns. It is called from several interrupt and file-handling routines.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:184D0
name: initialize_record_table_defaults
description: Fills a table of 64 records with default sentinel values, storing minimum and maximum values in a repeating pattern. It runs once per table reset and returns.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:18718
name: clear_bitplane_rows
description: Clears a rectangle of bytes in a bitplane by writing zeros down rows that are 40 bytes apart, starting at an offset computed from the position arguments. The row count and width come from the arguments.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:18C74
name: dispatch_run_length_command
description: Reads a signed command byte from a stream. A non-negative command calls a handler selected from a jump table, while a negative command copies a repeated run of values into the output.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:18C96
name: copy_byte_block_unrolled
description: Copies a block of bytes from a source pointer to a destination pointer through an unrolled sequence of byte moves, then calls a helper.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:18E9C
name: draw_scanline_segment_from_message
description: Reads a signed opcode from a message record. Negative opcodes are passed on with position offsets to a drawing call, and other opcodes update counters and call the scanline segment routine repeatedly.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:18F0A
name: update_tile_bitmask_for_coordinates
description: When its control byte is zero it calls a helper. Otherwise it walks a set of coordinate pairs and uses the tile bitmask routine to clear or set the matching bit for each one.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:18F28
name: offset_coordinate_pairs_into_buffer
description: Copies coordinate pairs from a source list into a global buffer, adding a running offset to each value, and calls a helper afterwards.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:18F44
name: write_offset_record_pairs
description: Walks a list of small records and, for each one that passes a flag check, writes a pair of coordinate words offset by running totals into a destination list. It calls a helper when done.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:18F68
name: accumulate_running_word_sums
description: Walks a buffer, accumulating running sums of words and storing each result into a destination buffer. It calls two helpers as it goes.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:18F8A
name: parse_message_table_record
description: Reads a message table record, initializes two offset globals from its first byte and then walks its entries, calling two helpers for each one. Part of the decompiled body is unavailable.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:19076
name: project_vertex_pair_with_rounding
description: Computes two projected coordinates from difference values and a scale factor using fixed-point multiplication with rounding, and stores them in the output pair. It then loops over a table of deltas and calls one other routine.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:19184
name: accumulate_record_offsets_by_flag
description: Chooses between two accumulation paths based on a flag word, seeding coordinate accumulators from record offsets and source values. It then calls two helpers; the visible body is partial.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:1920C
name: subtract_scaled_position_offsets
description: Subtracts scaled coordinate differences from the record's two position fields using fixed-point rounding, then stores the results in the accumulators. It calls helpers, including the tile bitmask routine.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:1928C
name: seed_coordinate_accumulators_from_record
description: Sets coordinate accumulators from a record's offset fields plus the first source pair, then processes further pairs through two helpers.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:1931A
name: project_vertex_with_record_offset
description: Computes a projected coordinate from difference values and a scale factor using fixed-point rounding, adds a record offset to it and writes it to the output. It then calls one helper.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:1937A
name: initialize_accumulators_and_loop
description: Sets two accumulators from input values shifted into the high word, then loops for a count and calls a helper on each step. The decompiled body is partial.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:193B0
name: scale_offsets_into_destination_buffer
description: Iterates over a buffer, adding increments to running coordinates and storing each scaled or offset value into a destination buffer. It calls two helpers during the loop.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:19B10
name: compute_line_segment_steps
description: Works out a line's coordinate steps from its two endpoints using shift and multiply operations, and calls a helper for each step. It is reached from the no-op line drawing routine.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:19B7C
name: step_line_segment_pixels
description: Walks pixels along a line segment using counters and coordinate deltas, calling a helper for each pixel. It is referenced through an address in code.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:19BD0
name: setup_line_edge_steps
description: Loads the endpoint values of one polygon edge, computes its step values and calls a helper. The visible body is partial.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:19BDE
name: apply_bitmask_to_grid_cells
description: Iterates through grid entries and applies bit masks to the cell values using a pointer and an offset, calling one helper. The visible body is partial.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:19F6A
name: multiply_rotation_matrix_terms
description: Computes fixed-point products of table values and combines them into result terms stored in globals. It chooses the empty line draw routine when a segment needs no drawing.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:1A058
name: lookup_packed_table_value
description: Reads a 32-bit value from a global table using an index derived from two globals and extracts a field from it, after calling a range-check helper. The body is partial.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:1A108
name: compute_range_check_value
description: Computes a value from fixed-point inputs and table values, and is called by the range check routine. The visible body is partial.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:1A17C
name: setup_3d_line_segment
description: Sets up one 3D line segment by computing fixed-point coordinates, checking signs and selecting the empty draw routine when the segment needs no drawing. It is called from the sine table update routine and several others.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:1A50E
name: shift_sorted_entries_backward
description: Walks backwards through a list of packed 32-bit entries, shifting entries whose sort key is larger and stopping at the bound. It returns once the insertion point is found.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:1A524
name: return_after_sign_test
description: Compares a value's sign against its shifted form and returns in both branches, so the pseudo-code shows no visible effect. It is called from three routines.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:1A54A
name: scan_sorted_entries_forward
description: Walks forward through a list of entries, comparing 16-bit keys, and stops when a key is no longer smaller or the bound is reached. It then computes a difference from the stopping entry.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:1A578
name: clip_and_store_span_bounds
description: Compares a span's start and end values against a limit, adjusts them and calls three helpers. The visible body is partial and it touches a custom chip register.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:1A5B8
name: build_span_flag_word
description: Builds a flag word from its inputs, setting one bit when a computed difference is negative, and calls a helper in a loop. The visible body is partial.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:1A5BE
name: clamp_span_start_and_flag
description: Clamps a span value against a bound, stores a flag word depending on which bound was reached, and calls one helper. The visible body is partial.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:1A5CC
name: build_span_flag_copy_table
description: Builds a flag word from a computed difference and calls a helper that copies a sequence of table entries into structure fields. The visible body is partial.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:1A66E
name: fill_table_entries_for_index
description: Writes a fill value through a pointer, then walks entries of a global table at an offset computed from an index and updates each entry's fields. The visible body is partial.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:1B2B4
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Stores one byte through a pointer; the rest of the decompiled body is filler from undecodable data, so this is a stub.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:1B2B8
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Stores one byte through a pointer; the rest of the decompiled body is filler from undecodable data, so this is a stub.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:00F4
name: run_handler_table_until_end
description: Counts down a timer global and, when it reaches zero, updates a handler global. It then reads bytes from a stream, calling the handler selected by each byte's value until a terminating byte is reached.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:029E
name: start_script_playback
description: Stores its argument, runs a three-step helper sequence and sets a display value depending on a global flag. It then parses the script byte stream with one of two argument sets.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:02D6
name: start_script_playback
description: Stores its argument, runs a three-step helper sequence and sets a display value depending on a global flag. It then parses the script byte stream with one of two argument sets.
